nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in StandardToken; never initialized or updated in this code.
Public mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, setTokens, burnTokens and burnMyTokens.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of ERC20 allowances.
STCDR token name string.
STCDR token symbol string.
STCDR decimals (8).
STCDR version string.
Maximum number of tokens that can ever be allocated; used as cap in setTokens and burnTokens.
Cumulative burned token counter, updated by burnTokens and burnMyTokens.
Cumulative allocated token counter, updated by setTokens.
Privileged owner wallet; set to msg.sender in constructor and changeable by changeFundWallet.
Mapping(address=>bool) of addresses allowed to receive/hold tokens; gates onlyWhitelist.
SafeMath.safeMul internal pure helper performing a*b with an overflow assert.
SafeMath.safeSub internal pure helper performing a-b with assert(b<=a).
SafeMath.safeAdd internal pure helper performing a+b with an overflow assert.
StandardToken.transfer, guarded by onlyPayloadSize(2); moves balances[msg.sender] to _to.
StandardToken.transferFrom, guarded by onlyPayloadSize(3); moves balances and decreases allowance.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Approves _spender for _value, requiring the current allowance to be zero if _value != 0.
Atomically changes an allowance from _oldValue to _newValue if the current value matches.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
STCDR constructor: sets fundWallet = msg.sender and whitelists the fundWallet.
Private helper that credits tokens to a participant, enforcing tokenCap and whitelisting the participant.
Fund-wallet-only external function that mints tokens to participant and optionally to a whitelisted recommended address.
Fund-wallet-only external function that burns up to amountTokens of a participant's balance.
Whitelist-only external function that burns the caller's own tokens.
Payable external entry point that forwards msg.sender to buyTo.
Payable, whitelist-only function whose body is require(false); effectively a disabled sale path.
Fund-wallet-only function that transfers the privileged fundWallet role to a new address.
STCDR override of transfer that delegates to StandardToken.transfer, dropping the onlyPayloadSize(2) guard.
STCDR override of transferFrom that delegates to StandardToken.transferFrom, dropping the onlyPayloadSize(3) guard.
Caller-controlled msg.sender, used for authorization, balance ownership and minting decisions.
Arithmetic accumulation of tokenAllocated inside setTokens; cap accounting depends on this sum.
Arithmetic safeSub(tokenCap, thisamountTokens) in the setTokens cap branch, reducing the credited amount.
Balance/tokenBurned arithmetic performed by burnTokens and burnMyTokens.
STCDR transfer/transferFrom overrides drop the onlyPayloadSize short-address-attack mitigation.
Approve allowance-change front-running race mitigated only by the zero-allowance requirement.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines which balance is debited in StandardToken.transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner checked and written in changeApproval.
Constructor assigns the privileged fundWallet and whitelist entry from msg.sender.
onlyFundWallet gate compares msg.sender against fundWallet before minting.
onlyFundWallet gate permits arbitrary burning of other holders' balances.
onlyWhitelist gate plus balances[msg.sender] used as the burn source.
buy() forwards msg.sender as the participant of buyTo.
onlyWhitelist gate on buyTo is evaluated against the caller forwarded from buy.
onlyFundWallet gate controls reassignment of the owner role.
STCDR.transfer override ultimately debits balances[msg.sender].
STCDR.transferFrom override consumes msg.sender's allowance.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to].
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances.
transferFrom reads balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom writes the updated source and destination balances.
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom decreases the stored allowance.
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
approve requires the existing allowance to be zero before overwriting.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
changeApproval requires allowed[msg.sender][_spender] == _oldValue.
changeApproval writes the new allowance value.
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
Constructor initializes the privileged fundWallet state variable.
Constructor whitelists the fundWallet address.
setTokens reads tokenAllocated to compute the projected allocation.
setTokens enforces tokenCap on the projected allocation.
setTokens reads the participant balance it is about to credit.
setTokens writes the new tokenAllocated total.
setTokens marks the participant as whitelisted.
setTokens increases balances[participant].
allocateTokens authorization depends on fundWallet state variable.

allocateTokens indirectly adds entries to the whitelist through setTokens.

burnTokens reads tokenBurned to compute the new cumulative burn.
burnTokens authorization depends on fundWallet state variable.
burnTokens writes tokenBurned.
burnTokens decreases balances[thisparticipant].
burnMyTokens reads balances[msg.sender] to clamp the burn amount.
burnMyTokens reads tokenBurned to compute the new cumulative burn.
burnMyTokens authorization depends on whitelist[msg.sender].
burnMyTokens writes tokenBurned.
burnMyTokens decreases the caller's balance.
changeFundWallet authorization depends on fundWallet state variable.
changeFundWallet overwrites the owner state variable.

buy() invokes buyTo(msg.sender).
STCDR.transfer delegates to super.transfer without the onlyPayloadSize guard.
STCDR.transferFrom delegates to super.transferFrom without the onlyPayloadSize guard.
setTokens performs safeAdd(tokenAllocated, thisamountTokens) cap arithmetic.
The accumulated allocation result is written back to tokenAllocated.
setTokens cap branch performs safeSub(tokenCap, thisamountTokens), altering the credited amount.
burnTokens performs balance and tokenBurned arithmetic on attacker-influenced amounts.
burnMyTokens performs balance and tokenBurned arithmetic on the caller supplied amount.
Burn arithmetic mutates the balances state variable.
Burn arithmetic mutates the tokenBurned state variable.

STCDR.transferFrom override removes the short-address payload size check.
The onlyPayloadSize numWords guard is never applied by the STCDR overrides.
approve allowance change is susceptible to the ERC20 front-running race.
